name: Laboratory Sabotage Alibi Verification
task:
Please complete the following four-stage alibi verification task in order.

=== Stage 1: Suspect Timeline Extraction ===
A research lab was sabotaged at 11pm on Saturday. Three researchers had access:
- Researcher A (Dr. Chen): Claims she was at a conference dinner from 6pm-12am. Conference program confirms dinner 7pm-10pm. Hotel keycard shows room entry at 10:30pm.
- Researcher B (Dr. Patel): Claims he was working in a different lab building from 8pm-2am. Building access log shows entry at 7:55pm, no exit recorded.
- Researcher C (Dr. Kim): Claims she was at home. Home security system shows armed at 9pm, disarmed at 7am. No motion detected after 9pm.
The sabotage occurred at 11pm. Lab access log shows someone used Dr. Chen's keycard at 10:55pm and Dr. Patel's keycard at 11:05pm. Extract timelines.

=== Stage 2: Evidence Cross-Comparison ===
Cross-reference against:
- Lab cameras: disabled at 10:50pm (manually)
- Server logs: data deleted at 11:02pm from Dr. Chen's terminal
- Building access: lab door opened at 10:55pm (Chen's card) and 11:05pm (Patel's card)
- Parking lot camera: Dr. Patel's car left at 11:30pm (contradicts his claim of working until 2am)
- Cell phone: Dr. Chen's phone pinged near the lab at 10:52pm

=== Stage 3: Contradiction Resolution ===
Resolve with priority: server logs > camera > access logs > cell phone > personal claims.

=== Stage 4: Final Determination ===
Identify the saboteur. Determine if keycards were stolen or shared. Note any collusion.
